Build the same ring with Stellarator Coils where the Central Solenoid and the Toroidal Field Coils go: twisted coils that make the plasma's whole field themselves. The block on the axis at the midplane decides which kind of reactor it is.
# Differences
- No plasma current: no Central Solenoid to charge, no pulses (it runs as long as it's fed and heated), no disruptions and no vertical instability.
- Its field is 90% of a tokamak's and it confines less well: about 60 to 70% of the power of a tokamak the same size.
- Past its density or beta limit it doesn't disrupt; the plasma simply goes out.
